purpose: Attests that these summaries came from live runs. They predate the _provenance stamp that tc.save_summary now adds. The RAG release gate accepts an unstamped summary only if its SHA-256 matches this file, so any later rewrite (e.g. a THIEL_SYNTHETIC=1 run) is refused until the notebook is re-run live, which stamps it.
evidence: unchanged since commit a80f205, the first commit of output/
no synthetic firm names (thiel_common's generators use 'FIRM <n>') in any summary or table
real company names throughout (e.g. Apple Inc., MICROSOFT CORPORATION, NVIDIA CORP)
hashing: SHA-256 of the file with CRLF normalised to LF (rag.release.text_sha256), so it is the same on every OS
